notes.title: Rules of Participation are set. No Returns.
notes.content: [h1][b]The Participation Rules Have Been Set. There's No Turning Back.[/b][/h1][p]You hear those whispers too, don't you? The moment you arrived on our page, the decaying walls of the De'Manor Hotel began to learn your name. You think you're here for a prize. How naive.[/p][p][/p][p]The puzzles in these halls aren't designed to test your intellect. They are the scattered fragments of rotting minds that lost their sanity here long before you. As you try to solve them, you will feel your own mind begin to fracture.[/p][p][/p][p]That other [b]"contestant"[/b] offering you a helping hand... Do you really think they are your friend? Or are they just calculating the easiest way to eliminate you? Here, every face is a mask, and every smile hides a dagger.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/f60d5c211965b6957c5bde2888dad0c9a7b07181.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Forget this: There is no prize to be won here.[/b] [/p][p][b]There is only a price to be paid.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]The bargain is for your soul. And the final signature you cast will seal the contract.[/p][p][b]If you want to be among the first to be summoned when the gates open, add the game to your wishlist. This will be your first, irreversible registration.[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3600200/Final_Signature/?curator_clanid=26335619"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]There's no need to follow us for updates. We are already watching you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]- The Management[/b][/p]
